questions.q: Explain in your own words why the author uses a compound sentence (la;qDr okD;) like "bldh ppkZ 'kgj esa Hkh iSQy xbZ vkSj 'kke rd xyh&xyh ls 'kk;j tek gksus 'kq: gks x,A" instead of two simple sentences in the narrative.
questions.a: The compound sentence mirrors the unbroken, suffocating spread of the news and the simultaneous progression of two events (crowd gathering and poet's fame spreading) – reflecting how bureaucracy and rumour work in tandem. A wrong answer that only defines "la;qDr okD;" as "two sentences joined by a conjunction" shows the student understands the structure but misses the stylistic function: the conjunction "vkSj" creates a breathless flow that mimics the uncontrollable spread of the story, a key satirical device.

questions.q: Analyze how the use of the Tatsam term "iQkWjsLV fMikVZeasV" (Working Plan Officer) instead of a simpler Hindi phrase like "karya yojna adhikari" contributes to the story's satire on colonial bureaucracy.
questions.a: The term "iQkWjsLV fMikVZeasV" is an exact transliteration of the British-era designation, carrying the weight of imperial forest management systems that prioritized commercial exploitation over ecological or human concerns. Its use – alongside "gkWVhZdYpj fMikVZeasV", "fMIVh lsozsQVjh" – creates a dense thicket of officialese that alienates the reader just as it alienates the villagers, making the bureaucracy feel impenetrable and absurd. A wrong answer that only translates the word misses the intertextual critique: Renu uses the colonizer's own vocabulary to expose its inhumanity.

questions.a: Third-person objective report is more appropriate because the story itself is narrated in third person with a detached, almost reportorial tone (e.g., "ekyh us ncs gq, vkneh dks nky&Hkkr f[kyk;k"), and the exercise asks for a "foèkk" (factual description) – a genre that demands impartial observation. A wrong answer choosing first-person because "it's more emotional" confuses the genre of factual description with personal narrative, a common board-exam error.
